sections.heading: About
sections.body:
I am an operations and administration manager based in Dhaka with 4+ years of experience. For the past three years I have run the working side of Imam Bukhari Trust: procurement, HR, compliance, construction coordination, events, and the systems that hold them together.

I trained as an electronics and telecommunication engineer and then took an MBA in supply chain management. That mix shapes how I work. I look for the process underneath a problem, write it down, and where I can, build a tool so nobody has to do it by hand again.

Outside operations I co-author research on Islamic education, prepare training material, and keep studying the Islamic sciences and Arabic.
